paper.title_en: Black Hole Entropy from Entangled Quantum Reference Frames
paper.abstract_en: In the extended phase space of Donnelly and Freidel, the edge modes of a Schwarzschild black hole are dynamical reference frames whose phase space is the cotangent bundle of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$. Gluing the two exterior regions at the bifurcation point leaves a single canonical pair. Within the extended phase space, this pair can be described either by Kuchař's mass and difference of asymptotic times or by the area and the relative rapidity of the two frames, which are two gauge choices of the same system. The latter is the pair of Carlip and Teitelboim, and the relative rapidity is the time shift of the crossed product construction. We quantize the frames in this gauge and construct the gravitational entangling product of the two exteriors. Requiring the frames to be causal restricts them to the semigroup $\mathrm{SL}^+(2,\mathbb{R})$, whose Plancherel measure yields the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy as the entanglement entropy between the two exteriors, together with a logarithmic correction, both independent of the ultraviolet cutoff.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在扩展相空间框架下结合量子参考系与交叉积构造，从Plancherel测度导出Bekenstein--Hawking熵及对数修正，并强调结果与紫外截断无关，理论深度与新颖性较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自纠缠量子参考系的黑洞熵
decision.abstract_zh: 在Donnelly与Freidel的扩展相空间中，Schwarzschild黑洞的边缘模式是动力学参考系，其相空间为$\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$的余切丛。在分叉点处将两个外部区域粘合起来会留下单一正则对。在扩展相空间内，这一对既可由Kuchař的质量与渐近时间差来描述，也可由两个参考系的面积与相对快度来描述，二者是同一系统的两种规范选择。后者正是Carlip与Teitelboim的那一对，而相对快度是交叉积构造中的时间平移。我们在此规范下量子化这些参考系，并构造两个外部区域的引力纠缠积。要求参考系是因果的，这会将它们限制在半群$\mathrm{SL}^+(2,\mathbb{R})$上，而该半群的Plancherel测度给出Bekenstein--Hawking熵，作为两个外部区域之间的纠缠熵，并附带一个对数修正，二者均与紫外截断无关。
